quarter.zh: 2027 财年第一季（9 月季度）

en: Revenue of $2.37B grew 50% (56% pro forma), led by Datacenter & Communications at $1.95B (+79%, 82% of the total), while Industrial fell 15% to $419M. Non-GAAP EPS of $2.09 beat the ~$1.98 estimate and non-GAAP gross margin rose to 40.6%. The Q2 guide of $2.55–2.75B was about 4% above consensus. Management expects FY27 growth above 60%, a $3B quarter by June 2027 and a $4B quarter in FY28, and the CFO raised the long-term margin goal to above 45% before the end of 2028. Capex jumped to $776M, so free cash flow was about −$868M and cash fell to $1.55B against $4.0B of debt.

The stock closed at $195.09 on Nov 4, about 45% below its pre-Q4 level and more than half below its June high, as AI hardware sold off. The report came after the close, so the first-session reaction is due on Nov 5. Investors will weigh the above-consensus guide and margin gains against the heavy capex and cash burn needed to scale indium phosphide capacity.
zh: 营收 23.7 亿美元，同比增长 50%（按备考口径 56%），其中数据中心与通信业务 19.5 亿美元（+79%，占总营收 82%），工业业务下降 15% 至 4.19 亿美元。非 GAAP 每股收益 2.09 美元，高于预期的约 1.98 美元；非 GAAP 毛利率升至 40.6%。第二季营收指引 25.5–27.5 亿美元，比市场预期高约 4%。管理层预计 FY27 增长超过 60%，2027 年 6 月前单季营收达到 30 亿美元，FY28 单季达到 40 亿美元；CFO 将长期毛利率目标上调至 2028 年底前超过 45%。资本开支升至 7.76 亿美元，自由现金流约 −8.68 亿美元，现金降至 15.5 亿美元，债务 40 亿美元。
股价 11 月 4 日收于 195.09 美元，较第四季财报前低约 45%，较 6 月高点下跌逾一半，原因是 AI 硬件板块回落。财报在收盘后发布，首个交易日的反应将在 11 月 5 日出现。投资者将权衡高于预期的指引和毛利率改善，与扩大磷化铟产能所需的高额资本开支和现金消耗。

bio.en: CEO since June 2024 after six years as CEO of Lattice Semiconductor, where margins and the stock rose sharply. Earlier ran AMD's computing and graphics business and held roles at Intel and Broadcom. Is refocusing Coherent on AI data-center optics and paying down debt.
bio.zh: 2024 年 6 月出任 CEO，此前任莱迪思半导体 CEO 六年，期间利润率与股价大幅提升。更早曾执掌 AMD 计算与图形业务，并在英特尔和博通任职。正将 Coherent 重心转向 AI 数据中心光器件并削减债务。

bio.en: Rejoined Coherent as CFO in 2024 from Lattice Semiconductor, where she had been CFO since 2019 alongside Anderson. Before that she spent 16 years at Coherent Inc., including as corporate VP of finance.
bio.zh: 2024 年从莱迪思半导体重返 Coherent 任 CFO，她自 2019 年起在莱迪思担任 CFO，与安德森共事。此前在 Coherent Inc. 工作 16 年，曾任财务副总裁。

sources.t: Q1 FY27 profit, segments and outlook (Investing.com)
